findings.description: From ~04.5s to ~06.75s the coin sits flat against the outside wall of the near cup, below the fingertips, as if adhered to the cup surface; only a fingertip touches its upper edge while the fingers otherwise rest on the cup rim, so the coin is not visibly gripped or pinned and appears stuck to the cup exterior while the hand moves.
